evidence_boundary: Static source and frozen installed-artifact evidence only; no Minecraft runtime was started and exact Feywild JAR bytecode parity remains unverified.

providers.grant: Pixie Wing Tiara refreshes fey_flying; the effect sets mayfly and flying when mayfly was false and records a persistent-data ownership flag.
providers.revoke: When fey_flying is absent and the ownership flag is set, the player tick handler clears mayfly and flying unconditionally.

providers.exact_jar_source_parity: release_tag_and_filename_match; binary class comparison not run
providers.grant: Core of the Void player-tick logic tracks username+logical-side in a process-local list and sets mayfly while the bound Curio has at least 100 mana available.
providers.revoke: When the tracked Core becomes invalid, unbound, removed, or lacks 100 mana, it clears mayfly, flying, and invulnerable for non-creative/non-spectator players without consulting other providers.
providers.intentional_restriction: The Extra Botany Gaia arena separately forces flying=false for participating non-creative players on client and server while the fight is active. It leaves mayfly intact and is documented upstream as an arena rule.
